home.welcome.title: Getting started sharing links.
home.welcome.description: LinkShelf is an open source Linktree alternative that you host yourself.
home.features.title: Everything you need to share your links
home.features.description: Group links into shelves, give them your own look, and run it all on your own server.
home.features.shelves.title: Shelves and sections
home.features.shelves.description: Organize links into shelves, split each shelf into sections, and reorder them by drag and drop.
home.features.users.title: Multiple users
home.features.users.description: Every user manages their own shelves. Users can register themselves or be invited by an admin.
home.features.domains.title: Custom domains
home.features.domains.description: Serve a shelf on a domain of its own, such as profile.example.com.
home.features.themes.title: Themes
home.features.themes.description: Style a shelf with a theme you create yourself or one the instance provides.
home.features.qrCodes.title: QR codes
home.features.qrCodes.description: Download a QR code for any shelf as SVG or PNG.
home.features.footer.title: Custom footer
home.features.footer.description: Replace the default footer of a shelf with your own text, including bold, italic and links.
home.features.selfHosting.title: Self-hosted
home.features.selfHosting.description: Run it with Docker or on Kubernetes with the Helm chart, on PostgreSQL or MySQL.
home.features.admin.title: Admin settings
home.features.admin.description: Manage users, themes and the content of pages like the imprint and privacy policy.
home.features.oidc.title: OIDC sign-in
home.features.oidc.description: Sign in with a local account or through any OpenID Connect provider.
home.cta.title: Ready to host your own?
home.cta.description: LinkShelf is self-hosted only. The docs cover Docker, Kubernetes and every configuration option.
